profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fresno County Superintendent of Schools
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer and leader with a demonstrated history of developing software for diverse organizations and various business domains (Environmental Health, Security Surveillance, Access Control, Public Health, Payroll). Skilled in Software Architecture, Network Protocols, Agile Methodologies (SAFe, Scrum), Web Development, Mobile Application Development, Embedded Software, and Windows Desktop applications. Substantial experience working with the .NET platform and associated technologies. Strong analytical and engineering skills with a well rounded educational background which includes a BS focused in Electrical Engineering (Computer Science and Math Minors) from California State University, Fresno. Extensive experience leading software engineering teams and supporting organizations with a large customer base.
